effects.lua_implementation: Synchro mix procedure requires LIGHT Tuner, non-Tuners, and a material-group Arckcestial.

official_references.matched_structure: Filtered Tuner plus non-Tuner Synchro procedure with subgroup condition.

effects.printed_clause: Opponent cannot target other LIGHT monsters you control.
effects.lua_implementation: Field cannot-target effect excludes this handler, targets LIGHT monsters, and returns true only for opponent effects.

official_references.matched_structure: Exact opponent-only protection for other archetypal/qualified monsters.

effects.printed_clause: If Synchro Summoned: Level becomes 4 until end turn; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed summon trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO and registers EFFECT_CHANGE_LEVEL=4 through PHASE_END under id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Target/handler Level becomes 4 until end turn.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from an "Arckcestial" Xyz to activate its effect: target a face-up field card and send it to GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_MOVE checks prior overlay, REASON_COST, activated Xyz effect, and archetype handler, then targets and sends a face-up card under separate HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Near-exact detached-as-Xyz-effect-cost trigger using previous overlay and reason checks.

coverage_override.reason: The LIGHT-Tuner/non-Tuner/Arckcestial material requirement is one Synchro procedure. The other-Light targeting protection, temporary Level-change trigger, and detached-material send trigger are the three effects; both activated HOPTs are included.
